entries.0ebb3e449e140352: Factory and equipment departments of manufacturers
entries.0f29a941dc93ece7: Factories of manufacturers, starting with the automotive-related field
entries.2f07dd67f2f05a34: This division sells factory production equipment through proposal-based sales that leverage the manufacturing function of the ＦＡ Division, and sells industrial production goods such as industrial grindstones, machinery and equipment, tools, and oils and fats. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,288 million.
entries.562884818f951e91: This division develops, designs, manufactures and sells the 'Alpha Frame System,' an aluminum alloy structural member that forms the basic frame of machinery and equipment, together with ＦＡ equipment using it (cleaning, inspection, conveying and packaging equipment), clean booths, etc. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,017 million.
entries.64d097dca433fc57: These are ＦＡ equipment (cup-type cleaning equipment, inspection equipment, and conveying and packaging equipment) based on the core technologies of 'cleaning,' 'inspection,' 'conveying' and 'packaging,' and clean equipment such as clean booths that create localized clean environments, etc. By using Alpha Frame as the basic member, manufacturing efficiency and shorter lead times are made possible.
entries.67eea757cede6ddb: Factories of manufacturers (demand source for consumables and jigs and fixtures)
entries.6e80a1d92e8ccf3d: Factory and equipment departments of a wide range of manufacturers, starting with the automotive-related field, semiconductors and electronic components, and pharmaceuticals and food
entries.818a13693ed893ee: A system consisting of an aluminum alloy structural member, 'Alpha Frame,' and auxiliary parts such as brackets, bolts and nuts; it can be assembled with bolts alone, without welding. It offers more than 2,200 types of products and also takes orders for frames with custom cross-sectional shapes for individual customers. It also provides design and assembly support services: 'Kakucha,' automatic design support using 3-dimensional ＣＡＤ, and a 'marking system' that prints assembly instructions directly onto the frames.
entries.946bea35f66ea894: It handles industrial grindstones used for various grinding processes, machinery and equipment ranging from general-purpose machine tools to dedicated equipment, cutting tools and holding tools such as end mills and drills, and oils and fats used for rust prevention and suppressing frictional heat. A feature is that consumables and jigs and fixtures have many repeat orders.
entries.c4ef7efdb0665bb8: A company that manufactures and sells the aluminum structural member "Alpha Frame System" and automation equipment, and also sells industrial production goods.
entries.fd78189ea88ee7c8: Major customers, starting with Canon Inc.
